* '''PC-E3''' ([[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual14-Light/large/endorchiefchirpashut.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/large/endorchiefchirpashut.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: You may not generate more than 2 Force at non-battlegrounds. It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 31 May 2022 (<code>Virtual14-Light/hires/endorchiefchirpashut.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
